supersedes: repo self-assessment tools/readiness_evaluator.nim + config/readiness_policy.json (NOT reused as independent criteria; repo evaluator used only as mechanical engine where semantics match)
productContract: v1: local dev CLI for verifying AI-generated Nim code. Surfaces: ax prove, ax report (ax status = candidate). Outputs: machine-readable verification result (JSON) + provenance-bearing local replay-bound verification artifact. Core promise: same canonical input + same execution contract -> reproducible verification result. Non-goals: CI platform, enterprise orchestration, portable standalone certification, certification/legal/regulatory guarantee.

stateSemantics.UNPROVEN: required evidence insufficient (never promoted to PASS)
stateSemantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: item in the pre-ratified scope exclusions only

blockingPolicy.CONDITIONAL_GO: all CRITICAL in {PASS} and at least one NON_CRITICAL in {FAIL, UNPROVEN}

preRatifiedNotApplicable: ax status as a primary product surface (v1 contract: Candidate surface only; not registered in CLI dispatch)
portable standalone self-contained certificate (v1 non-goal; artifact is local replay-bound only)
single synthesized canonicalInputHash field (v1 contract uses (sourceHash, irHash) pair as input identity)
